scope: Read sealed and prepared report content from offline combined backups separately from editable drafts
behavior: Retains only parsed report content from canonicalReport returned by the existing authenticated recovery validator, alongside the validated snapshot.
Renders dedicated sealed/prepared report disclosures with semantic report fields and existing local attachment-metadata checks.
Clearing inspection also drops both report views. No provider initialization, ledger query or session installation is added.

unit.scope: Real encrypted report with divergent editable draft, prepared v4 recovery, valid AES envelope with an invalid report commitment rejected before rendering, plus panel/attachment regression.

earlierRuns.reason: Prepared fixture lacked attachment metadata and used an old version; invalid-commitment fixture was rejected by export validation before reaching import.
Prepared fixture still declared version 2 with a version 4 uncertainty field. Corrected to version 4.

validation.invalidCommitmentMethod: Intercept only the plaintext input to real AES encryption after export validation, change report.id, then let real import crypto and commitment validation reject the resulting encrypted backup.

browser.scope: Desktop/mobile show the sealed title while a different draft title exists, preserve offline behavior, prevent horizontal overflow with opened report/draft, and remove content on clear.

release.scope: Normal web typecheck/build and release manifest after browser tests.

limits: Cryptographic checks bind the saved report to its saved commitment, not to independently authenticated current ledger state.
Attachment bytes remain separate; no native-wallet, full regression or container refresh is claimed.
Browser-copy storage is mocked in component tests; the browser journey uses a local encrypted file and a synthetic connector.
